$comment: The `table` binding is an InferOpsTableSession from the inferops gatekeeper (custom-gatekeepers/gatekeeper-inferops). blueprintId is the install key: never rename it.
title: InferOps Records
description: Use to view the rows of one InferOps custom table, read-only, with the columns its owner did not mark personal. Needs one InferOps custom table connected as the `table` binding. The connection is private to the person who made it, so a gadget using it cannot be shared.

table.title: InferOps custom table
table.description: The InferOps custom table this gadget shows, e.g. inferops://demo.local/object/table/70000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001.
